```{r module-8-monte-carlo, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
        collapse = ", " ) ) )

})

config <- list( n_replications = 10L, base_seed = 20262000L, seed_stride = 100L, output_dir = file.path(
      project_root, "outputs", "monte_carlo_stability" ), replications_dir = file.path( project_root, "outputs",
      "monte_carlo_stability", "replications" ), module1_template =
    file.path(project_root, "01_generate_synthetic_motor_portfolio.Rmd"), module2_template =
    file.path(project_root, "02_fit_technical_pricing_model.Rmd"), module3_template =
    file.path(project_root, "03_construct_synthetic_quote_market.Rmd"), module4_template =
    file.path(project_root, "04_generate_conversion_outcomes.Rmd"), module5_template =
    file.path(project_root, "05_fit_conversion_models.Rmd"), module6_template =
    file.path(project_root, "06_constrained_pricing_simulation.Rmd"), overwrite_existing_replications = FALSE,
  # Stability criteria.
  minimum_replication_completion_rate = 0.90, minimum_central_stability_rate = 0.90,
  minimum_truth_margin_retention = 1.00, minimum_truth_conversion_uplift = 0.00,
  development_rate_neutral_tolerance = 0.005, expected_module1_version = "M1-MULTIYEAR-2026-09-09",
  expected_module1_policies = 50000L, expected_policy_year = 2025L, expected_quote_profiles = 10000L,
  expected_conversion_train_rows = 6000L, expected_conversion_validation_rows = 2000L,
  expected_conversion_test_rows = 2000L, expected_module5_version = "M5-GLMGAM-OOT-2026-09-18",
  expected_module5_mc_safe_marker = "M5-GLMGAM-OOT-2026-09-18-MC-SAFE", expected_module6_version =
    "M6-GLMGAM-OOT-2026-09-18", expected_conversion_model_families = c( "glm", "gam" ),
  expected_conversion_candidates = c( "Technical-only GLM", "Own-price GLM", "Relative-price GLM", "Rank GLM",
      "Market-position GLM", "Market-position GAM" ), baseline_targeting_basis_id = "vehicle_value_band",
  write_plots = TRUE )
dir.create(
  config$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
dir.create(
  config$replications_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
# 0.1 EARLY OUTPUT-DIRECTORY WRITE TEST

write_probe_connection <- tryCatch( file( write_probe_path, open = "w" ),
    error = function(e) {
      NULL
    } )

        config$output_dir, 2 ) ) )
}
close( write_probe_connection )
unlink( write_probe_path, force = TRUE )
```

# 1. CORE HELPERS
safe_divide <- function( numerator, denominator
) {
  result <- numerator / denominator
  result[ !is.finite( result ) ] <- NA_real_
  result
}
normalise_r_path <- function( path
) {
  gsub( "\\\\", "/", path )
}
r_string <- function( x
) {
  paste0( '"', normalise_r_path( x ), '"' )
}
write_csv_resilient <- function(x, file, ...) {
  dir.create(dirname(file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  tryCatch({
    readr::write_csv(x, file, ...)
    invisible(file)
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Unable to write output ", file, ": ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
  })
}
all_checks_pass <- function( file_path
) {
  if ( !file.exists( file_path )
  ) {
    return( FALSE )
  }
  checks <- suppressMessages( readr::read_csv( file_path, show_col_types = FALSE ) )
  if ( !"pass" %in% names( checks ) || nrow( checks ) == 0L
  ) {
    return( FALSE )
  }
  # Modules 2 and 5 contain diagnostic rows that may be labelled
  # required_for_progress = FALSE. Those are substantive results rather than
  # mechanical pipeline failures.
  if ( "required_for_progress" %in% names( checks )
  ) {
    required_flag <- as.logical( checks$required_for_progress )
    required_flag[ is.na( required_flag ) ] <- TRUE
    checks <- checks[ required_flag, , drop = FALSE ]
  }
  if ( nrow( checks ) == 0L
  ) {
    return( FALSE )
  }
  all( as.logical( checks$pass ) )
}
named_metric <- function( data, metric_name, name_column = "metric", value_column = "value"
) {
  if ( !all( c( name_column, value_column ) %in% names( data ) )
  ) {
    return( NA )
  }
  value <- data[ as.character( data[[ name_column ]] ) == metric_name, value_column, drop = TRUE ]
  if ( length( value ) == 0L
  ) {
    NA
  } else {
    value[ 1 ]
  }
}
first_or_na <- function(x) {
  if ( length( x ) == 0L
  ) {
    return( NA_real_ )
  }
  x[ 1 ]
}
check_observed_value <- function( checks, check_name
) {
  if ( !all( c( "check_name", "observed_value" ) %in% names( checks ) )
  ) {
    return( NA_real_ )
  }
  value <- checks$observed_value[ checks$check_name == check_name ]
  if ( length( value ) == 0L
  ) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    as.numeric( value[ 1 ] )
  }
}
check_observed_value_pattern <- function( checks, pattern
) {
  if ( !all( c( "check_name", "observed_value" ) %in% names( checks ) )
  ) {
    return( NA_real_ )
  }
  hit <- grepl( pattern, checks$check_name, ignore.case = TRUE )
  value <- checks$observed_value[ hit ]
  if ( length( value ) == 0L
  ) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    as.numeric( value[ 1 ] )
  }
}
module1_monte_carlo_checks_pass <- function( checks
) {
  required_columns <- c( "check_name", "pass" )
  if ( !all( required_columns %in% names( checks ) )
  ) {
    return( FALSE )
  }
  nonblocking_checks <- c( "Mean annual kilometres", "Vehicle-value floor share", "Annual claimant rate",
      "Mean paid claim severity", "Total-loss cost share", "Standardised non-total-loss severity mean",
      "Conditional non-total-loss gross CV", "Mean true technical premium", "Mean latent geographic effect",
      "Maximum motive-power probability deviation", "Maximum finance-status probability deviation",
      "Maximum vehicle-colour probability deviation", "Vehicle-modification prevalence",
      "Pre-existing-damage prevalence", "Policyholder is regular-driver prevalence",
      "Vehicle-segment fallback share", "Vehicle-specification donor fallback share",
      "Each cohort annual-km mean within 250 km of target" )
  blocking_failures <- checks %>% filter( !pass, !check_name %in% nonblocking_checks )
  nrow( blocking_failures ) == 0L
}
count_module1_policies <- function( modelling_file
) {
  if ( !file.exists( modelling_file )
  ) {
    return( NA_integer_ )
  }
  nrow( readr::read_csv( modelling_file, col_select = 1, show_col_types = FALSE ) )
}
extract_r_chunks <- function( rmd_path, r_script_path
) {
  lines <- readLines( rmd_path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8" )
  extracted_lines <- character()
  in_r_chunk <- FALSE
  chunk_count <- 0L
  for ( line in lines
  ) {
    if ( !in_r_chunk && grepl( "^\\s*```\\{r(?:[ ,}].*)?$", line )
    ) {
      in_r_chunk <- TRUE
      chunk_count <- chunk_count + 1L
      next
    }
    if ( in_r_chunk && grepl( "^\\s*```\\s*$", line )
    ) {
      in_r_chunk <- FALSE
      extracted_lines <- c( extracted_lines, "" )
      next
    }
    if ( in_r_chunk
    ) {
      extracted_lines <- c( extracted_lines, line )
    }
  }
  if ( in_r_chunk
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Unclosed R code chunk in: ", rmd_path ) )
  }
  if ( chunk_count == 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "No R code chunks found in: ", rmd_path ) )
  }
  writeLines( extracted_lines, r_script_path, useBytes = TRUE )
  invisible( chunk_count )
}
insert_before_first_active_line <- function( lines, target_line, inserted_lines, label
) {
  matches <- which( trimws( lines ) == target_line )
  if ( length( matches ) == 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Could not find insertion target '", target_line, "' while patching ", label, "." ) )
  }
  insert_at <- matches[ 1 ]
  c( if ( insert_at > 1L
    ) {
      lines[ seq_len( insert_at - 1L ) ]
    } else {
      character()
    }, "",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "# MODULE 8 REPLICATION OVERRIDES",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------",
    inserted_lines, "", lines[ insert_at:length( lines ) ] )
}
write_replication_script <- function( template_path, patched_rmd_path, r_script_path, insertion_target,
    override_lines, module_label
) {
  lines <- readLines( template_path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8" )
  patched_lines <- insert_before_first_active_line( lines = lines, target_line = insertion_target, inserted_lines =
        override_lines, label = module_label )
  writeLines( patched_lines, patched_rmd_path, useBytes = TRUE )
  extract_r_chunks( rmd_path = patched_rmd_path, r_script_path = r_script_path )
  tryCatch(
    {
      parse( file = r_script_path, keep.source = FALSE )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      stop( paste0( module_label, " generated an invalid R script: ", conditionMessage( e ) ) )
    } )
  r_script_path
}
run_script_isolated <- function( script_path, module_label
) {
  message( "    Running ", module_label, " in isolated R process..." )
  rscript_path <- file.path( R.home( "bin" ), "Rscript" )
  if ( !file.exists( rscript_path )
  ) {
    rscript_path <- Sys.which( "Rscript" )
  }
  if ( !nzchar( rscript_path ) || !file.exists( rscript_path )
  ) {
    stop( "Could not locate the Rscript executable required for Module 8." )
  }
  log_path <- sub( "\\.R$", "_run.log", script_path )
  original_working_directory <- getwd()
  on.exit(
    {
      setwd( original_working_directory )
      invisible( gc( verbose = FALSE ) )
    }, add = TRUE )
  setwd( project_root )
  status <- tryCatch(
      {
        system2( command = rscript_path, args = c( "--vanilla", shQuote( script_path ) ), stdout = log_path,
          stderr = log_path )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        structure( 1L, controller_error = conditionMessage( e ) )
      } )
  if ( is.null( status )
  ) {
    status <- 0L
  }
  status <- as.integer( status )
  if ( identical( status, 0L )
  ) {
    return( list( success = TRUE, error_message = NA_character_, log_path = log_path ) )
  }
  log_tail <- character()
  if ( file.exists( log_path )
  ) {
    log_lines <- tryCatch( readLines( log_path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8" ),
        error = function(e) {
          character()
        } )
    if ( length( log_lines ) > 0L
    ) {
      log_tail <- tail( log_lines, 150L )
    }
  }
  error_text <- paste( log_tail, collapse = "\n" )
  if ( !nzchar( error_text )
  ) {
    error_text <- paste0( "Rscript exited with status ", status, ". See log: ", log_path )
  }
  list( success = FALSE, error_message = paste0( module_label, " runtime failure in isolated R process (status ",
        status, "): ", error_text, "\nFull module log: ", log_path ), log_path = log_path )
}
assert_template_contains <- function( file_path, required_text, template_label
) {
  if ( !file.exists( file_path )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( template_label, " template not found: ", file_path ) )
  }
  template_text <- paste( readLines( file_path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8" ), collapse = "\n" )
  if ( !grepl( required_text, template_text, fixed = TRUE )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( template_label, " does not match the final frozen contract. Expected marker: ", required_text,
        ". Resolved file: ", file_path ) )
  }
  invisible( TRUE )
}

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 5. MODULE PATCH FUNCTIONS
set_module1_monte_carlo_validation_policy <- function( file_path
) {
  lines <- readLines( file_path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8" )
  start_matches <- which( trimws( lines ) == "if (!all(validation_checks$pass)) {" )
  if ( length( start_matches ) != 1L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Could not locate the frozen Module 1 final validation gate in ", file_path, "." ) )
  }
  start <- start_matches[ 1 ]
  stop_matches <- which( grepl(
        'stop("One or more required Module 1 validation checks are outside their stated bounds.")', lines,
        fixed = TRUE ) & seq_along( lines ) >= start )
  if ( length( stop_matches ) != 1L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Could not locate the frozen Module 1 validation stop in ", file_path, "." ) )
  }
  close_candidates <- which( trimws( lines ) == "}" & seq_along( lines ) > stop_matches[ 1 ] )
  if ( length( close_candidates ) == 0L
  ) {
    stop( "Could not locate the end of the Module 1 validation gate." )
  }
  end <- close_candidates[ 1 ]
  replacement <- c(
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "# MODULE 8 MONTE CARLO VALIDATION POLICY",
    "# --------------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "# Frozen Module 1 uses tight baseline calibration bounds. Across random seeds,",
    "# moderate misses are Monte Carlo outcomes rather than reasons to discard a",
    "# replication. Structural/data-integrity failures remain blocking.",
    "module8_nonblocking_module1_checks <- c(", '  "Mean annual kilometres",', '  "Vehicle-value floor share",',
    '  "Annual claimant rate",', '  "Mean paid claim severity",', '  "Total-loss cost share",',
    '  "Standardised non-total-loss severity mean",', '  "Conditional non-total-loss gross CV",',
    '  "Mean true technical premium",', '  "Mean latent geographic effect",',
    '  "Maximum motive-power probability deviation",', '  "Maximum finance-status probability deviation",',
    '  "Maximum vehicle-colour probability deviation",', '  "Vehicle-modification prevalence",',
    '  "Pre-existing-damage prevalence",', '  "Policyholder is regular-driver prevalence",',
    '  "Vehicle-segment fallback share",', '  "Vehicle-specification donor fallback share",',
    '  "Each cohort annual-km mean within 250 km of target"', ")", "", "module8_failed_module1_checks <-",
    "  validation_checks |>", "  dplyr::filter(!pass)", "", "module8_blocking_module1_failures <-",
    "  module8_failed_module1_checks |>", "  dplyr::filter(!check_name %in% module8_nonblocking_module1_checks)",
    "", "if (nrow(module8_failed_module1_checks) > 0L) {",
    '  cat("\\nModule 1 Monte Carlo validation misses:\\n")', "  print(module8_failed_module1_checks, n = Inf)",
    "}", "", "if (nrow(module8_blocking_module1_failures) > 0L) {",
    '  stop("One or more structural Module 1 validation checks failed in Monte Carlo.")', "}", "",
    "if (nrow(module8_failed_module1_checks) > 0L) {", "  warning(",
    '    "One or more non-structural Module 1 calibration checks were outside ",',
    '    "their baseline bounds in this Monte Carlo draw. Outputs are retained ",',
    '    "and the misses are treated as stochastic stability diagnostics."', "  )", "}" )
  lines <- c( if ( start > 1L
      ) {
        lines[ seq_len( start - 1L ) ]
      } else {
        character()
      }, replacement, if ( end < length( lines )
      ) {
        lines[ (end + 1L): length( lines ) ]
      } else {
        character()
      } )
  writeLines( lines, file_path, useBytes = TRUE )
  invisible( file_path )
}
patch_module1 <- function( replication_row, paths
) {
  dir.create(
    paths$scripts, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
  dir.create(
    paths$module1, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
  patched_rmd <- file.path( paths$scripts, "01_module1_replication.Rmd" )
  r_script <- file.path( paths$scripts, "01_module1_replication.R" )
  override_lines <- c( paste0( "config$seed <- ", replication_row$module1_seed[ 1 ], "L" ), paste0(
      "config$output_dir <- ", r_string( paths$module1 ) ), "config$write_plots <- FALSE" )
  generated_script <- write_replication_script( template_path = config$module1_template, patched_rmd_path =
        patched_rmd, r_script_path = r_script, insertion_target = "set.seed(config$seed)", override_lines =
        override_lines, module_label = "Module 1" )
  set_module1_monte_carlo_validation_policy( patched_rmd )
  set_module1_monte_carlo_validation_policy( generated_script )
  parse( file = generated_script, keep.source = FALSE )
  generated_script
}

  override_lines <- c( paste0( "config$input_file <- ", r_string( file.path( paths$module1,
          "synthetic_motor_modelling.csv" ) ) ), paste0( "config$claims_file <- ", r_string( file.path(
          paths$module1, "synthetic_motor_claims.rds" ) ) ), paste0( "config$truth_file <- ", r_string( file.path(
          paths$module1, "synthetic_motor_full_truth.rds" ) ) ), paste0( "config$output_dir <- ", r_string(
        paths$module2 ) ), "config$write_plots <- FALSE" )
  write_replication_script( template_path = config$module2_template, patched_rmd_path = patched_rmd,
    r_script_path = r_script, insertion_target =
      "dir.create(config$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)", override_lines = override_lines,
    module_label = "Module 2" )
}
patch_module3 <- function( replication_row, paths
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 6. RUN COMPLETE BASELINE PIPELINE FOR EACH REPLICATION
replication_status_rows <- list()
for ( replication_index in seq_len( nrow( replication_register ) )
) {
  replication_row <- replication_register[ replication_index, ]
  replication_id <- replication_row$replication_id[ 1 ]
  replication_label <- replication_row$replication_label[ 1 ]
  paths <- replication_paths( replication_label )
  message( "" )
  message( "============================================================" )
  message( "Monte Carlo replication ", replication_id, " of ", config$n_replications, ": ", replication_label )
  message( "============================================================" )
  dir.create(
    paths$root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
  if ( !config$overwrite_existing_replications && replication_complete( paths )
  ) {
    message( "  Existing completed replication found; reusing outputs." )
    replication_status_rows[[ replication_label ]] <- tibble( replication_id = replication_id, replication_label =
          replication_label, replication_success = TRUE, module_failed = NA_character_, error_message =
          NA_character_, reused_existing_outputs = TRUE )
  } else {
    replication_success <- TRUE
    module_failed <- NA_character_
    error_message <- NA_character_
    patchers <- list( "Module 1" = patch_module1, "Module 2" = patch_module2, "Module 3" = patch_module3,
      "Module 4" = patch_module4, "Module 5" = patch_module5, "Module 6" = patch_module6 )
    for ( module_name in names( patchers )
    ) {
      if ( !replication_success
      ) {
        break
      }
      patched_script <- tryCatch( patchers[[ module_name ]]( replication_row = replication_row, paths = paths ),
          error = function(e) {
            e
          } )
      if ( inherits( patched_script, "error" )
      ) {
        replication_success <- FALSE
        module_failed <- paste( module_name, "patch/parse" )
        error_message <- conditionMessage( patched_script )
        break
      }
      module_result <- run_script_isolated( script_path = patched_script, module_label = module_name )
      if ( !module_result$success
      ) {
        replication_success <- FALSE
        module_failed <- module_name
        error_message <- module_result$error_message
        break
      }
    }
    replication_status_rows[[ replication_label ]] <- tibble( replication_id = replication_id, replication_label =
          replication_label, replication_success = replication_success, module_failed = module_failed,
        error_message = error_message, reused_existing_outputs = FALSE )
  }
  # Write an incremental status checkpoint after every replication.
  current_status <- bind_rows( replication_status_rows ) %>% arrange( replication_id )
  write_csv_resilient( current_status, file.path( config$output_dir, "monte_carlo_replication_status.csv" ) )
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 7. FINAL EXECUTION STATUS
replication_status <- bind_rows( replication_status_rows ) %>% left_join( replication_register, by = c(
      "replication_id", "replication_label" ) ) %>% arrange( replication_id )
write_csv_resilient( replication_status, file.path( config$output_dir, "monte_carlo_replication_status.csv" ) )
if ( !any( replication_status$replication_success )
) {
  cat( "\nNo replication completed successfully. Failure details:\n" )
  print( replication_status %>% dplyr::select( replication_id, replication_label, module_failed, error_message ),
    n = Inf, width = Inf )
  stop( paste( "No Monte Carlo replication completed successfully.",
      "The failure details are printed above and saved in", "monte_carlo_replication_status.csv." ) )
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
        selected_multipliers$selected_multiplier ), targeted_multiplier_range = max(
        selected_multipliers$selected_multiplier ) - min( selected_multipliers$selected_multiplier ),
    targeted_distinct_multipliers = n_distinct( selected_multipliers$selected_multiplier ) )
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 9. COLLECT ALL SUCCESSFUL REPLICATIONS
collected_rows <- list()
for ( replication_index in seq_len( nrow( replication_register ) )

  replication_id <- replication_row$replication_id[ 1 ]
  replication_label <- replication_row$replication_label[ 1 ]
  status_row <- replication_status %>% filter( replication_id == .env$replication_id )

        status_row )
}
replication_summary <- bind_rows( collected_rows ) %>% arrange( replication_id )
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
        targeted_development_rate_level - 1 ) <= config$development_rate_neutral_tolerance + 1e-12,
    market_information_logloss_gain_pass = collection_success & selected_log_loss_improvement_vs_own_price > 0,

    true_conversion_improvement_pass = collection_success & targeted_true_conversion_uplift_pp >

      targeted_true_margin_retention + 1e-12 >= config$minimum_truth_margin_retention,
    final_architecture_contract_pass = collection_success & architecture_contract_pass & module5_contract_pass &
      module6_contract_pass & portfolio_size_contract_pass, predictive_conclusion_stable = collection_success &
      all_pipeline_checks_pass & final_architecture_contract_pass & selected_model_interface_pass &
      market_information_logloss_gain_pass & market_information_truth_gain_pass, pricing_conclusion_stable =
      collection_success & all_pipeline_checks_pass & final_architecture_contract_pass &
      selected_model_interface_pass & neutral_targeted_feasibility_pass & development_rate_neutral_pass &
      true_conversion_improvement_pass & true_margin_preservation_pass, central_conclusion_stable =
      predictive_conclusion_stable & pricing_conclusion_stable )
write_csv_resilient( replication_summary, file.path( config$output_dir, "monte_carlo_replication_summary.csv" ) )
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 13. CONTINUOUS-METRIC STABILITY SUMMARY
continuous_metrics <- c( "module1_claimant_rate", "module1_mean_paid_severity", "module1_total_loss_cost_share",
  "module1_mean_true_technical_premium", "technical_loss_cost_truth_spearman", "technical_loss_cost_mean_ratio",
  "focal_commercial_adjustment_r_squared", "realised_focal_conversion_rate", "rank_conversion_spearman",
  "relative_price_conversion_spearman", "selected_model_test_log_loss", "selected_model_test_auc",
  "selected_model_test_calibration_slope", "gam_validation_relative_logloss_improvement_vs_glm",
  "gam_validation_calibration_slope", "selected_model_interface_max_probability_difference",
  "selected_log_loss_improvement_vs_own_price", "selected_relative_log_loss_improvement_vs_own_price",
  "selected_auc_improvement_vs_own_price", "selected_truth_probability_spearman",
  "own_price_truth_probability_spearman", "truth_recovery_spearman_gain", "targeted_development_rate_level",
  "targeted_development_margin_retention", "targeted_development_min_segment_margin_retention",
  "targeted_development_min_age_margin_retention", "targeted_development_claim_ratio",
  "targeted_development_conversion_retention", "targeted_true_conversion_rate",
  "targeted_true_relative_conversion_uplift", "targeted_true_margin_retention", "targeted_true_claim_ratio",
  "targeted_test_rate_level", "targeted_multiplier_mean", "targeted_multiplier_range" )
completed_results <- replication_summary %>% filter( collection_success )
monte_carlo_stability_summary <- completed_results %>% dplyr::select( all_of( continuous_metrics ) ) %>%
  pivot_longer( cols = everything(), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value" ) %>% group_by( metric ) %>%
  summarise( replications = sum( is.finite( value ) ), mean = mean( value, na.rm = TRUE ), sd = sd( value,
        na.rm = TRUE ), minimum = min( value, na.rm = TRUE ), q25 = quantile( value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE,
        names = FALSE ), median = median( value, na.rm = TRUE ), q75 = quantile( value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE,
        names = FALSE ), maximum = max( value, na.rm = TRUE ), coefficient_of_variation = if_else( is.finite( mean
        ) && abs( mean ) > 1e-12, abs( sd / mean ), NA_real_ ), .groups = "drop" )
write_csv_resilient( monte_carlo_stability_summary, file.path( config$output_dir,
    "monte_carlo_stability_summary.csv" ) )
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
registered_replications <- nrow( replication_register )
```
